$note: Enlift baseline rationale: Read/Grep/Glob are safe defaults. Git is read-only by default; commits and pushes require explicit approval. Bash is denied for anything that touches credentials, makes network calls, or destroys data. To request a new allowed tool, open a PR and document why in your CLAUDE.md.
